name: THE_WOMEN
canonical: the women who followed Jesus from Galilee (Mary Magdalene, Joanna and others), first-century Judean women of varied ages, olive-skinned Hebrew faces, in simple wool tunics with mantles drawn over the head and muted natural earth-tone dyes and sandals; Mary Magdalene a resolute woman in her thirties, Joanna dignified and middle-aged, plus an older grey-haired woman
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock the women witnesses' identity across scenes.
